title: Media Studio — photo / social design canvas
description: Lightweight photo/social studio. Tool rail (move/text/rect/ellipse/sticker with shortcuts), checkerboard canvas with live CSS-filter adjustments + 8 named presets, per-layer clip masks and custom CSS, text/shape/sticker/image/HTML-embed layers, social aspect presets with platform safe-area guides (TikTok/Reels/IG/YouTube), debounced undo+redo, and JSON/HTML export + import (os-rr/layers@1). Fully offline: new image layers pull from bundled SVG data-URI samples; host fs persistence and a real media library inject via configureMediaStudio (lib/host.ts).
